bundle.shortDescription: Bond, a desktop companion that keeps your day on track.
bundle.longDescription: SelfGlance is a Windows desktop companion. Write today's list in the morning; Bond notices when you drift from it, reminds you to take breaks and drink water, and does small jobs on the laptop. Everything runs on your laptop: no account, no cloud.
